'''J9-B8''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] variant freed by his mistress. He traveled through the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] with his friend [[R4-W9]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Bandin Dobah]] and his gang attacked the two friends to steal R4-W9 and left J9-B8 dismantled. He managed in calling for help, but it was too late for him.
